text.p: Zurich Group said it expects another good overall result for 1997, barring extraordinary events.
"Unless faced with exceptional events, we expect to achieve another good overall result for the 1997 financial year," the life and non-life insurance group said in its annual report.
Zurich Group in April reported that its 1996 net profit rose 30 percent to 1.138 billion Swiss francs ($821.5 million) and gross insurance premiums were up by 20.5 percent to 31.9 billion.
At that time it said the consolidation of new companies, especially Kemper Group of the U.S., accounted for about half of the gross premium growth.

In addition to the Kemper acquisition last year, Zurich Group acquired the Norwegian company Protector, it bought a majority stake in Seguros Sud America in Venezuela, received approvals for a second representive office in China and opened a laison office in India.
In January this year Zurich offered to buy the outstanding publicly held shares of Zurich Reinsurance Centre Holdings, a New York Stock Exchange quoted company in which it owns a 66 percent stake.
